analysis:
Examined StartCommand+Modes.swift (head) and StartCommand+Picker.swift (patch and base). The Picker change only delegates pickerLoadBudgetGiB and modelFitsBudget to AutopilotBuildEligibility.loadBudgetGiB and fitsLoadBudget. The removed logic (finite check, memory <= 4096, hard cap minus load headroom) is not visible in the delegate, so the AutopilotBuildEligibility implementation is unverified. It is a memory-fit availability concern with no direct confidentiality or authorization effect. Not a finding.

Modes.swift (runForeground, lines ~210-236) adds AutopilotStartInventory.load, called with coordinatorURL and the config directory. It is skipped when config.coordinator.privateOnly, so private-only providers do not contact the catalog. The inventory(from: verified) and pending(local:hashed:) results feed ProviderLoopConfig.autopilotInventory and autopilotPendingCandidates. Verified weight hashes still come from attachWeightHashes. Pending candidates are verified after registration by the provider, so they are not advertised without a hash. If inventory(from:) admits entries without weightHash, that would relate to T-027/T-012 (weight-hash routing gate). That implementation is outside the supplied evidence. The fallback path keeps the previous weightHash non-empty filter. Line 489 adds selection.noteAutopilotCachedBuilds(await loop.autopilotCachedBuildHashes), which feeds hashes into the next scheduled window. It is unclear whether those hashes are bound to the verified-hash store or recomputed. Open questions for integration: (1) whether AutopilotStartInventory.load trusts the catalog (a coordinator-supplied, trusted source) safely when it fetches a response, and whether the fetch is authenticated or leaks the auth token; (2) whether the post-registration verification of pending builds fully hashes before advertising; (3) equivalence of the AutopilotBuildEligibility budget with the old UnifiedMemoryCap logic. No concrete regression is visible in the supplied lines. The local-endpoint token fail-closed behavior (lines 320-339) and the --local token handling are unchanged. needs_deeper_review is set because the new helper types are not supplied.
